MOA: block K · ↑ phase 3 · ↑ AP → ↑ ERP @ Atrial-Ventricular tissue
⍉FDA-approved for AFib - most effective to maintain NSR, but extensive extracardiac toxicity (pulm, thyroid, hepatic, ocular, neuropathy) → reserve for pts who fail/⍉tolerate other AADs
Pulm fibrosis           	     	-       GI                                                                                - Ataxia, dizziness		-       Neuropathy,
Photosensitivity · ophthalmic effects 	-       musc weak · tremor
Also: corneal microdeposits - hypothyroidism (blocks T4→T3) - hepatitis - epididymitis - CV (MC→least): hypotension · ♡ block · dysrhythmias · brady · ↑QT - GI upset (N/V/taste disturb)
▪︎pulm toxicity/ILD: onset USU w.in 6–12 mo of starting (may be 2 mo to several yrs) → progress DOE · dry cough · crackles - CXR: reticular pattern
ACLS (pulseless VT/VF): 300 mg IV/IO - 2nd dose 150 mg
▪︎stable VT: option w procainamide · synchronized cardioversion (esp. refractory)
SE:  MUST BE ADMINISTERED IN HSP
